acquisition: Peptides were measured on an Exploris 480 Orbitrap mass spectrometer.
labeling: dimethyl labelling and liquid chromatography tandem mass spectrometry were performed
The resultant peptides were then dimethyl labelled and combined
Corresponding labels were selected for “Light” (DimethLys0 and DimethNter0) and “Medium” (DimethLys4 and DimethNter4) labels.
enrichment: Affinity purification coupled with mass spectrometry proteomics

Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (interactomics) using dimethyl labeling for quantification. Acquisition is inferred as DDA based on the use of MaxQuant/Andromeda and the Orbitrap Exploris 480 in a standard discovery interactomics context, although not explicitly stated as 'DDA' in the text.

scope: Immunoprecipitation-based mass spectrometry interactomics data revealed that during senescence induction and maintenance, p21CIP1 specifically inhibits CDK4 and thereby activates the DREAM complex.

For identification of p21CIP1 binding partners, cells were either non-treated or treated with 1 μM B[a]P for 48 and 120 h. Thereafter p21CIP1 was immunoprecipitated and protein in-gel digestion, dimethyl labelling and liquid chromatography tandem mass spectrometry were performed.
Anti-p21 pull-downs were performed in replicating MCF7 cells or cells treated with benzo[a]pyrene for 48 h or 120 h.
Affinity purification coupled with mass spectrometry proteomics

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics analysis specifically targeted the p21CIP1 interactome using immunoprecipitation (pull-downs), which classifies the sample scope as an affinity-purified complex. While the text mentions nuclear extracts and nuclear foci in other contexts, the MS material itself was the immunoprecipitated p21CIP1 complex.
